params.1274: Get a ranged weapon. (Defeating Kayle in The Blood Pact will cause him to drop a sling for you).
params.1275: Click on your inventory to open that sidebar, then click on the sling to wield it.
params.1276: You can see your equipped sling in the equipment screen, and remove it if you wish by clicking on it again.
params.2225: Some weapons (such as bows) require ammunition. Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock offers free bows if you don't wish to use a sling.
